newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 30.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch-May 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Friday:

** Indian engineering and construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T) on Thursday reported a net profit of 4.11 billion rupees for the year ended March 31, 1997 against 3.88 billion in the year-ago period.

** L&T is looking for minority participation in a steel venture, company officials said. Kulkarni said L&T was talking to global steel majors, including some Japanese firms, but declined to elaborate saying negotiations were at a premature stage.
** Indian Petrochemical Corporation Ltd (IPCL) is headed for the bond market with a 4.5 billion rupee, five-year paper, the Economic Times reports.
The paper says the offering will be sold to institutional investors through book building from June 10.
** The Indian rupee opened steady at 35.79/80 against the dollar on Friday, dealers said.
The rupee is seen gaining in the absence of major dollar demand on the horizon, dealers said.
** Bombay's benchmark share index .BSESN closed 38.80 points higher at 3,724,11 on Thursday on the back of a five percent rally in Reliance shares triggered by foreign fund buying, traders said.
